Here's The Reason Why this should Be core in the engine not an add on.

["Why should this be core and not an add-on?"]

[Editor Integration (The "2D View" Barrier):]
An add-on cannot easily modify the core UI of the Godot Editor to add a "2D/3D Toggle" or create draggable Gizmos that feel native. To make the 2D View Mode they must be integrated into the engine's source code.

[Long-term Stability & Performance]
Third-party add-ons often break during minor engine updates (e.g., 4.2 to 4.3), creating friction for long-term projects. By integrating this into the Core, it ensures:

First
 C++ Optimization: Better editor performance in large 2.5D scenes.

Second 
Version Guarantee: The feature is maintained and tested by the Godot team for every release.

Third
Reliability: Professional studios can rely on these tools without worrying about an add-on becoming "abandoned" by its creator.
